Notice: The Noble County Tax Map Office has proposed amendments to the Conveyance Standards. Public hearings will be held on July 22 at 10:00 a.m. and August 3 at 10:00 a.m. in the Commissioners Office located in the Courthouse. These changes will directly affect deeds and surveys. We encourage all attorneys and surveyors to review the proposed amendments on our website. If adopted, the revised standards will be enforced by our office and will go into effect August 3, 2026.
Click here to view proposed amendments
ATTENTION: Proposed amended standards were approved on August 3rd, 2026, and go into effect August 3rd, 2026. PREAPPROVAL IS NOW REQUIRED. SEND BY EMAIL.

About Noble County
Establishment
Noble County was established in 1851. It was named for pioneer James Noble, the first settler to buy land there in 1814 ( Noble County Flag | Ohio Statehouse , n.d.).
The County Flag
The red, white and blue flag was designed by Charles Stoneking, incumbent county commissioner, in 1985, and adopted by the Commission that same year. The white “O” stands for Ohio, the blue “N” for Noble, and the 15 white stars represent the 15 townships of the county. The red, white, and blue colors were chosen to identify with the United States of America. This information was collected from a county clerk by John Purcell ( Noble County Flag | Ohio Statehouse , n.d.).

Addressing Info
The Noble County Map Office / Noble County Engineer’s Office is the Addressing Authority for Noble County. Please contact either office for assistance.
Address Request Form
If a new driveway is to be installed, a Driveway Permit must be completed with the Engineer’s Office prior to a new address being assigned.
Permit applications can be emailed (hsecrest@noblecountyohio.gov), faxed (740-732-1059) or mailed to Noble County Engineer’s Office, ATTN: Halie Secrest, 46003 Marietta Road, Caldwell, Ohio 43724-9277
